scripts.dev: npm run ensure-ui-deps && npm --prefix ui run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.build: npm run ensure-ui-deps && npm --prefix ui run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist/ui',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('ui/dist','dist/ui',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html','DisciviumOpen Discivium');"
scripts.lint: npm run ensure-ui-deps && npm --prefix ui run lint
scripts.preview: npm run ensure-ui-deps && npm --prefix ui run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.test: npm run ensure-ui-deps && npm --prefix ui test
